description: The 42nd Contracting Squadron at Maxwell Air Force Base (AFB), Alabama, intends to award a sole source, firm fixed price (FFP) contract to Cartridge Technologies, LLC, 15738 Crabbs Branch Way, Rockville, Maryland 20850, for the lease and servicing of multifunction copy machines in accordance with the attached Draft Statement of Work (SOW). The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 532420 with a size standard of $40,000,000.00 (forty million dollars).
